_comment: Each entry lets one advisory through the audit gate until `expires` (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). After that date the gate fails again. Only for an advisory with no fixed release; ADR or PS entry required.

exceptions.reason: No fixed picomatch release exists (4.0.7 is latest; upstream PR micromatch/picomatch#246 open). Build-time only: vite, vitest, dependency-cruiser and the static Astro site match our own globs, never an untrusted one.
